name: Yoshitomi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yoshitomi town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised lozenge.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshitomi, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 May 1982.

features.role: Yoshitomi town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised lozenge
